rows.note: Use this all-purpose colloquial choice when hair, string, wires, or similar things have formed knots.

example.english: I haven't brushed my hair for too long, and now it's all tangled.
example.traditional: 我啲頭髮太耐冇梳，依家打晒結喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 di1 tau4 faat3 taai3 noi6 mou5 so1 ji1 gaa1 daa2 saai3 git3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when separate strands, wires, or objects are intertwined with one another rather than simply knotted.

example.english: The wires under the sofa are tangled together, so I can't tell which one is which.
example.traditional: 梳化底啲電線纏埋一齊，搞到我分唔清邊條打邊條。
example.jyutping: so1 faa2 dai2 di1 din6 sin3 cin4 maai4 jat1 cai4 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 fan1 m4 cing1 bin1 tiu4 daa2 bin1 tiu4
